programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programs.sub_title: Make Your Own Takeout: Thai Chicken and Basil
programs.desc: When Rachael's Upstate New York home leaves her short on takeout options, she turns to her favorite solution: MYOTO, or Make Your Own Takeout. This time, she's cooking up a vibrant Thai Chicken and Basil stir-fry loaded with vegetables and Thai chilies, served over jasmine rice. To complete the meal, John mixes a Thai Collins, his fresh twist on the classic Tom Collins made with gin, muddled peppers, basil, and more.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programs.sub_title: Pork Burgers with Veggies and Mozzarella
programs.desc: From her kitchen in Upstate New York, Rachael recreates an unforgettable Tuscan-inspired burger. Served on a fluffy kaiser roll with fresh tomatoes, this hearty pork burger is topped with melted mozzarella and provolone, layered with roasted zucchini, eggplant, and peppers, and served alongside scooped fries with a rich balsamic ketchup for dipping.

programs.title: The Chef's Garden
programs.desc: Chef Zane Holmquist from Stein Eriksen Lodge in Deer Valley, Utah, is still amazed by the breadth and beauty of The Chef's Garden after twenty years of working with Farmer Lee. Bringing his simple, mountain-Western style to the test kitchen, he turns freshly picked rhubarb into a fun, savory dish of rhubarb chutney with lamb, goat yogurt, and grilled rhubarb.

programs.title: The Chef's Garden
programs.desc: Executive Chef Rachael Weiner of The Farmhouse at The Ojai Valley Inn joins Farmer Lee Jones at The Chef's Garden to celebrate summer squash at its peak. She's mixing summer squash fresh from the fields with mussels and wine to create an escabeche.
